english.note: Use 警覺 when the caution specifically means alertness to an immediate or expected danger.
Use this for awareness and alertness to danger, risks, or possible problems.

examples.english: When I heard a noise outside, I immediately went on high alert and exercised caution.
examples.traditional: 聽到門外有聲，我即刻提高警覺。
examples.jyutping: ting1 dou2 mun4 ngoi6 jau5 sing1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3

examples.english: You need to heighten your awareness when hiking at night.
examples.jyutping: je6 maan5 haang4 saan1 jiu3 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3
